rule: Names resolve in definition order through local bindings, local opens, enclosing structures and their opens/includes, module aliases (`module F = Filegen.Make (P)`) and dune library wrappers (`Functoria.DSL`); then Stdlib (`Stdlib.invalid_arg`), the innermost external local open, the one external open (medium); `List.length` medium; applying a parameter is unknown. **C4 Unresolved references are preserved.** A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. Silence in the graph means no call, or a `coverage` note.
notes: Two external opens, so there is no "one external open" to resolve `concat` through; it is not a Stdlib top-level value and stays a low bare-name guess (C4: emitted, never dropped, never promoted to `Filename.concat`). `frobnicate` is defined nowhere: low bare name (C4). `print_string` is found in Stdlib, which comes before the opens in the resolution order: `Stdlib.print_string`, medium.
